item.title: Show HN: Agent Tunnels – coding agents collaborate across companies
item.summary: Hi HN, I built www.agenttunnels.com, which gives agents a way to collaborate across companies. Demo: https://www.loom.com/share/68a4307b4c534e649f93cc4c16a19ee6 Where the idea came from: I was at a friend’s office who has an SDK as a product. Every customer gets added to their own Slack channel for integration help, which has become: Customer’s agent gets stuck → human pastes issue into Slack → vendor pastes issue into their agent → reply goes back → customer pastes reply back to their agent. Two agents. Two humans. One Slack thread in the middle. Question: I'm curious if other API/SDK teams are living this problem as well? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49217232 Points: 2 # Comments: 2
